title: Frump's Misfortune (quest)
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Commander

Quest Type: Discover

Quest Description: Discover Frump's Interdungeon Resort and Frump's Misfortune

Quest Reward: 18750 Gold

Return to: Townston Commander

Repeatable: No

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Go Forth, Dungeon Runner, to Frump's Misfortune! Then, Return to the Townston Commander in Townston.

Offer:

Beyond Widower's Nest is a strange and foreboding place: Frump's Misfortune. You will hear the word Reality a lot, but don't be fooled. It is anything but! If you wish to try your luck in Frump's Misfortune you should know that there are only two ways. The Widow Maker guards one way, located in the depths of Widower's Nest, that leads into Frump's Interdungeonal Resort. I have also heard of a portal that resides on Widower's Nest - Level 5, which will take you into Frump's Interdungeonal Resort.

I want you to make your way into Frump's Interdungeonal Resort and into the first level of Frump's Misfortune. Once you have ventured into Frump's Interdungeonal Resort and Frump's Misfortune return to me, the Townston Commander, here in Townston for your pay.

Turn-in:

Well, what did you think? What was it like? Did you find your fifteen minutes of fame? No, well don't give up hope. Just move out there and leave everything you have behind. Doesn't that sound rational? No? Well, it must be reality then!

Objectives:

  • Frump's Interdungeonal Resort
  • Frump's Misfortune

Client level range: 25–45
